answer.rationale: With the line at 94% committed volume and the contract expiring in 14 days, switching primary supply creates unacceptable continuity risk—especially given the low-cost vendor's repeated SLA misses. A time-boxed incumbent negotiation, using market benchmarks to target price and payment concessions, is the most feasible single-cycle path toward the mandated spend reduction while preserving delivery continuity. Verify the low-cost vendor delivery history and the prior negotiation outcome before committing.
